name: volume-control
title: Volume control
description: A mute button and volume slider that remembers the last level, steps with the arrow keys, says the level in words and folds into a popover when space is short.
docs: value is the level from 0 to 1 and muted is a separate flag, so muting keeps the level and unmuting puts it back (from a level of nothing, the last audible one). Control both with onChange and onMutedChange (set media.volume and media.muted there), or leave them to defaultValue and defaultMuted. Moving the slider while muted unmutes. The arrow keys move the level by step (0.05, so 5 percent), Page keys and Shift by half, Home and End go to the ends; on a muted slider a key steps from the level that was muted and unmutes. M mutes and unmutes from the button or the slider. A screen reader hears 'Volume 60 percent' or 'Muted', and the button is named Mute or Unmute. showValue writes the level as a number. With compact the slider stands upright in a popover behind a small button, for a control bar with no room to spare. labels replaces the words.
